## RALD JWT — Architecture Note

**The RALD JWT is auto-generated and self-contained within the RALD infrastructure.**  
- `RALD_JWT_SECRET` is an internal secret, owned and rotated by RALD itself — not a third-party dependency
- App tokens are scoped per `appId` with 1h expiry
- Handoff tokens have 5min expiry
- SSO v2 schema: `sso_v: 2` payload field
- JWT signing and verification happen exclusively inside `rald-auth-core` Worker — no external JWT service

This is a strong security posture: no third-party JWT vendor, no shared signing key across external systems.

---

## Checks

### ✅ JWT Validation
- `signJwt()` + `verifyJwt()` — HMAC-SHA256, internally managed
- App-scoped tokens: 1h expiry (`expiresIn: 3600`)
- Handoff tokens: 5min expiry (`expiresIn: 300`)
- No JWT verification delegation to external services

### ✅ Session Security
- `RALD_SESSION_KV` — server-side session storage (Cloudflare KV)
- HttpOnly cookies via `buildSessionCookie()`
- `authMiddleware` validates session on every protected route

### ✅ Rate Limiting
- KV-backed per-IP rate limiting (`src/lib/rate-limit.ts`)
- Separate KV namespaces per service: auth, notify, search, inbox, realtime
- `getClientIp()` extracts real IP from CF-Connecting-IP header

### ✅ RBAC
- `authMiddleware` — user-level access
- `adminMiddleware` — admin-only routes
- Roles stored in JWT payload and enforced at route level
- ADMIN_EMAILS environment variable for admin guard in Manilla

### ✅ Redirect Validation
- `validateRedirectUrl()` — allowlist: `*.rald.cloud`, `*.ostloop.name.ng` only
- `https:` protocol enforced
- Applied to every SSO exchange and handoff route

### ✅ Secret Management
- All secrets via Cloudflare `wrangler secret put` — never in code
- JWT secret is internally generated and managed by RALD
- GitHub Actions secrets: `GH_PAT` naming fixed (GITHUB_* blocked by GitHub)

### ⚠️ CSP (Content Security Policy)
- Not confirmed in reviewed Worker code
- Cloudflare Pages CSP headers not verified
- **Required:** Add `Content-Security-Policy` headers to all Pages deployments

### ⚠️ HSTS
- Not confirmed in reviewed code
- Cloudflare typically handles HSTS at edge — needs verification at dashboard level

### ⚠️ Secret Scanning
- No automated secret scanning (e.g., truffleHog) observed in CI pipelines

### ⚠️ Upload Validation
- Auth core has no file uploads (N/A)
- Loop/Manilla media upload validation not audited in this phase
